channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Would this BOLD Coaching Hire Push Detroit Lions Over the Top?
item.description: With Jim Schwartz reportedly unhappy in Cleveland, should the Detroit Lions consider bringing their former head coach back to help elevate the defense in 2026?

item.title: Penei Sewell Nominated for Inaugural NFL Award
item.description: Detroit Lions star tackle Penei Sewell has been nominated for the NFL’s first-ever Protector of the Year Award, joining elite offensive linemen from Kansas City, Denver, Miami, and Chicago.

item.title: Detroit Lions Could Target Former Colts HC for Assistant Role
item.description: The Detroit Lions could be looking to add another highly respected defensive voice to Dan Campbell’s staff, and one name makes a ton of sense: former Indianapolis Colts head coach Chuck Pagano. The idea was first floated by Jeremy Reisman…

item.title: How One Line in Kerby Joseph’s Contract Is Sparking Huge Debate About His Knee
item.description: A closer look at Kerby Joseph’s contract reveals injury protection clauses and limited guarantees that may hint the Detroit Lions had long-term concerns about his knee.

item.title: Former Lions QB Says Offensive Coordinator Fell Asleep During the Game
item.description: Former Lions QB Dan Orlovsky shared a jaw-dropping story about an offensive coordinator falling asleep mid-game during his time in Detroit.

item.title: Fred Warner Takes Shot at Dan Campbell Over Lions’ Injury Problems
item.description: 49ers linebacker Fred Warner playfully questioned Dan Campbell’s live-tackling practices after Amon-Ra St. Brown revealed how physical Lions training camps really are.

item.title: ESPN Names Best NFL Coaching Hires of the Past Half-Decade
item.description: ESPN’s Bill Barnwell ranked Dan Campbell as the best NFL head coaching hire of the last five years, praising his rebuild of the Detroit Lions and aggressive mentality.

item.title: Detroit Lions Sign Former Chicago Bears Tight End
item.description: The Detroit Lions have signed former Chicago Bears tight end Thomas Gordon to a futures contract after his rookie NFL season.

item.title: Is Cole Payton the Detroit Lions QB of the Future?
item.description: With Jared Goff firmly in place, could North Dakota State QB Cole Payton be a smart developmental draft pick for the Detroit Lions?

item.title: Detroit Lions Welcome ‘Josh and Jase’ to Ford Field
item.description: The Detroit Lions welcomed viral British travel creators Josh and Jase to Ford Field after their popular tour across Michigan captured statewide attention.
